career_ladder.note: The RSMSSB Common Eligibility Test (Graduation Level) is a statutory gateway examination under the Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services (Common Eligibility Test) Rules, 2022. It governs recruitment to graduate-level executive and supervisory posts listed in Schedule I of the Rules, including Junior Accountant & Tehsil Revenue Accountant (Level L-10), Platoon Commander (Level L-10), Sub-Jailor (Level L-10), Supervisor - Women Empowerment (Level L-10), Village Development Officer (Level L-6), and Patwari (Level L-5). The career progression outlined below reflects the premier financial executive cadre recruited through this gateway (Junior Accountant / TRA in the Rajasthan Subordinate Accounts Service).

exam_scheme.note: Under Rule 7 of the Rajasthan Subordinate and Ministerial Services (CET) Rules 2022, the Graduate Level CET consists of a single-stage objective written examination of 150 questions carrying 300 marks for a duration of 3 hours. There is no negative marking. Performance generates a scorecard valid for qualifying candidates for 15-times category-wise shortlisting in subsequent post-specific recruitment examinations.

stages.source_label: RSMSSB CET Graduate Level Detailed Advertisement & Syllabus (Advt. 09/2024)

papers.paper_name: Composite Paper — Indian National Movement & History of India/Rajasthan, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science & Technology, Reasoning & Mental Ability, General Hindi, General English, Computer Knowledge & Current Affairs
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking in Common Eligibility Test
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit scorecard generated; candidates scoring top 15x category vacancies or 40% aggregate eligible for departmental mains examinations

financial_package.note: Package computed for the primary graduate-level benchmark post recruited through CET (Junior Accountant / Tehsil Revenue Accountant, Level L-10) under the Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. During the mandatory two-year probation period in Rajasthan, a fixed trainee remuneration of ₹23,700 per month is paid without allowances. Upon successful completion of probation, regular entry basic pay of ₹33,800 is drawn in Level L-10.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Level L-10 Matrix
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on Level L-10 entry basic pay of ₹33,800 at 58% DA (₹19,604 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18% depending on city classification: ₹3,042 to ₹6,084), city compensatory allowance where applicable, net of State Insurance & General Provident Fund / RGHS deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per Rajasthan Finance Department notifications
House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 9% (Y/Z areas) or 18% (Jaipur and major cities)
Comprehensive cashless medical coverage under Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS)
Pension coverage under Rajasthan Civil Services Pension Rules (Old Pension Scheme restored in 2022)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual privilege leave encashment benefits
